text: Rung section, rung 1 to rung 13: 4,020 mm at 335 mm pitch; 13 rungs

Deepest water on a 1.5:1 slope with two rungs still at or below the water line: 2,127 mm below the coping
Vertical wall, water 3,000 mm below the coping: bottom rung 1,170 mm below the water line; 4 rungs at or below it; deepest water with two rungs at or below it: 3,835 mm
Clear width between rope bushes 298 mm; rung pitch 335 mm; hand clearance behind the float sleeve at a stand-off rung 70 mm
Side rope cut length 7.95 m each (15.89 m in all) at 55 g/m

Ladder as thrown (everything that leaves the box): 4.27 kg against the 4.5 kg target of R2 (-0.23 kg; +0.27 kg against the earlier 4.0 kg)
Saving with 25.4 x 1.65 mm rungs instead: 0.20 kg (rejected: see D2)
Net buoyancy per rung with its share of rope: plain rung 0.277 kg, stand-off rung 0.221 kg (target at least 0.15 kg)
Throw weight in water 0.442 kg; bottom three rungs lift 0.775 kg, factor 1.75 (target at least 1.5)
Whole ladder in water: 2.93 kg of spare lift; it floats with the weight hanging below
Rung tube 28.6 x 1.65 mm 6061-T6: section modulus 890 mm3; 1.5 kN at mid-span over 320 mm gives 120 N m and 135 MPa, 0.56 of the 240 MPa minimum yield (target at most 0.67)
Lighter 25.4 x 1.65 mm tube: 175 MPa, 0.73 of yield (over the 0.67 limit, so not used)
Each rung end puts 750 N through the bush flange onto the knot; nylon flange bearing about 17 MPa on a 2 mm contact band (nylon yields at about 50 MPa)
Stand-off block on a 1.5:1 slope: wall force 612 N per block (whole climber on one rung), friction torque 17.4 N m, 610 N across the M5 bolt (two shear planes, capacity about 6 kN each)
One 9 mm side rope with a stopper knot, wet: 18 x 0.6 x 0.85 = 9.18 kN; both ropes 18.4 kN; factor 4.08 on the 4.5 kN target (R4 asks for at least 4; Amish's floor for the smaller rope is 3)
Over an unprotected 10 mm coping edge as well: 9.2 kN for both ropes; the edge protectors keep the rope off the edge
Screw links: working load limit 1,000 kg = 9.8 kN, 2.18 times the 4.5 kN target
Design climber 100 kg with a 1.5 dynamic factor: 1.47 kN
On the 1.5:1 slope the ropes carry the part along the wall, 0.82 kN (friction on the wall ignored); on a vertical wall the whole 1.47 kN
Person holding a rung in a 2.0 m/s current: drag 700 N on the person and 106 N on three rungs (Cd x A 0.35 m2, rung Cd 1.2)
Upper bound on the anchor (climbing a vertical wall and the full current drag together): 2.32 kN, 1.94 times inside the 4.5 kN target
Eye nut M16 working load limit 700 kg in line = 6.87 kN, 1.53 times the target
M16 grade 8.8 bolt: proof load 94 kN; post wall under the 50 mm washer, punching capacity 66 kN
Post 60 x 60 x 3: section modulus 12,380 mm3; 4.5 kN at 250 mm gives 1125 N m and 91 MPa, 0.39 of yield

Standard footing at every site, 500 dia x 1,200 deep, short rigid pile (Broms), drained medium dense granular soil (unit weight 18 kN/m3, 30 deg): ultimate 16.1 kN, factor 3.58 on the target (target at least 1.5)
Same footing in saturated soil (submerged unit weight 8 kN/m3): 7.2 kN, factor 1.59 (target at least 1.5); the earlier 400 dia x 1,000 deep footing gave only 3.8 kN, factor 0.85
Concrete in the standard footing 0.232 m3, about 22 bags of 25 kg

Deploy time estimate: lift the lid 2 s; take the throw weight and the top of the folded ladder 4 s; throw upstream of the person 4 s; let the ladder pay out down the wall 5 s; total 15 s (target under 30 s; to be timed)
UV: ropes, rungs and foam live in an opaque UV-stabilised box and see daylight only when used or inspected
Nothing hard is thrown: the throw weight is a soft shot pouch; rung ends are capped and holes bushed; a blunt-tip knife is kept in the lid
Value-engineering target: USD 500. Estimated cost of the constructable design: USD 605.20 (USD 105.20 over the target)
Station (post, footing, anchor, box, decals, knife, consumables) USD 358.80; ladder USD 246.40
